papers.reason: proposes a tripartite conceptual framework (ethical governance, symbiotic human-AI collaboration, equitable innovation) for balancing AI adoption with academic integrity; no enumerable categories or dimensions describing a disclosure, attribution, or provenance claim, just high-level principles and recommendations

proposes a Human-in-the-Loop Professional Adaptation Framework (four layers) and a core competency framework for lecturers (feedback literacy, rubric/content validation, data interpretation and equity, integrity and clarity); these describe professional roles and institutional layers, not categories, fields, or values used to classify a disclosure, attribution, or provenance claim about produced work

schemes.empirical_basis: one ESL academic writing course, practitioner-inquiry design in a single instructor's classroom
